regent_decisions.S6_empty_schema: accepted — the five examples serve as its base
regent_decisions.S7_source_raw: REJECTED — carried only by examples and by teaching models of Glyph itself; the surface where the XML is pasted does not necessarily read Glyph
regent_decisions.S8_references: accepted, with a refinement: normative material must outrank example material, because model authored examples rot fast
regent_decisions.S10_language_sweep: CONFIRMED — promoted from assumption to lock T13
regent_decisions.order_home: the guidelines directory, deliberately not ignored; .scope would make the change disappear
regent_decisions.skill_layout: SKILL.md at the root, scripts/glyph-parser.js beside it, references/ at source level holding the generic official pattern of the XML output with everything needed to explain it including the failure treatments, and references/examples/ nested below it. The generic pattern does not rot because it describes the shape rather than an instance; examples are fridge items, bound to one input and one engine version
regent_decisions.divide_operator: DELETED — the slash belongs solely to the emotion delimiter. The architect's positioned-diagnostic recommendation is superseded; the removal must take the machinery out too, not only the documentation row
regent_decisions.malformed_input: an unparseable operator run is deliberately incomprehensible to Glyph and gets an error treatment: bucket N at fix severity, no fabricated mood element, the discarded token reported, a position carried
regent_decisions.duplication_resolved: references/ and the conformance vectors are not two copies of one truth: the vectors are specific input-to-output pairs living in the repository and are the test, while references/ sits one level of abstraction above them and is generic. D9 and E2 point at the vectors, not at the reference
regent_decisions.backslash: ABANDONED, per I-19. Removed from the engine in this release alongside the divider
regent_decisions.source_of_truth: the resulting AST is, from here forward, officially and immutably the source of truth. It is parseable and readable by every generative model that receives text, which is what makes it portable and internally verifiable. The .json serves as the directive export, carrying the structure and significance of the whole project; the .xml carries the real instructions. The XML remains the pasted deliverable, but it is a projection of the AST rather than a peer of it
regent_decisions.Q2_diagnostic_positions: ANSWERED by implication of the source-of-truth decision: serializeAST projects diagnostic positions. A refusal with no coordinate is not verifiable by a reader who does not have the engine, and verification by other models is the reason the AST was promoted
regent_decisions.extension: the source extension is .pgml — pure glyph markup language — never .glyph, which is already taken in another context. The repository already uses .pgml throughout the CHANGELOG and BUNDLE_TARGET; the .glyph naming in version 3 of this order was an error and has been renamed
regent_decisions.no_format_is_dropped: a generated document is never dropped for lacking a consumer. It is improved until it has one. If the harness does not exploit .hgml, .hgml is improved so the harness can; the same holds for .pgml and model tracing
regent_decisions.target_of_v4: the glyph-package specification, chosen over the remaining split and the descriptive comparison report; it is the item the handoff marked blocked
regent_decisions.branch: claude/reload-skills-3059f5, fast forwarded to 4fdd668; the work no longer lives on claude/reload-skills-f5b866 and that branch is not advanced in parallel
regent_decisions.cadence: one step per commit, npm run check exiting zero before the next step opens
regent_decisions.glyph_package_referent: RESOLVED (Q7) - glyph-package is the emitted document root, succeeding <glyph> and carrying <invoke> and <chain>, per OPERATOR_TARGET.md sections 3.4 and 9. The six-layer bundle of BUNDLE_TARGET.md is a different artefact and keeps its own name. scripts/glyph-check.js line 20 misnames it and is corrected in this release.
regent_decisions.root_replacement: unconditional: <glyph-package> replaces <glyph> for every emission, not only where a chain or invoke occurs. Declared as assumption S18, architect recommendation on Q8
regent_decisions.invoke_element: RESOLVED (Q10) - <invoke> is the COMMAND call, and must mean 'function' to the model receiving the document. Not the template call: <template>, define, expanded and means are unchanged. Specified in PACKAGE_TARGET.md section 4

verified_findings.finding: unrecognised shapes in the operator and delimiter region fail without a usable diagnostic. [in-/rwk] emits <rework/> with NO diagnostic and /zzz/ falls to <off>/zzz/</off> with NO diagnostic; the backslash forms emit a [note] that reports the wrong thing

verified_findings.note: the architect predicted [in-/rwk] would fall to <off>/rwk</off>; verified, it already emits <rework/> today. The silence is the point; the predicted shape is not what happens
verified_findings.correction: an earlier version of this finding said the backslash form was silent as well. It is not — it emits [note] UnknownEmotion. The error was mine: the probe read parse().diagnostics, which is always undefined because parse() returns {segments, gaps, tokens} and the diagnostics live in gaps. Every 'no diagnostic' reading taken through that field was vacuous rather than measured, and the ones that survive here were re-confirmed through the CLI --diag
